content: CEFTIN Tablets and CEFTIN for Oral Suspension are pharmaceutical formulations that contain cefuroxime in the form of cefuroxime axetil, a semisynthetic, broad-spectrum cephalosporin antibiotic intended for oral use. Chemically, cefuroxime axetil is the 1-(acetyloxy) ethyl ester of cefuroxime, with the chemical name (RS)-1-hydroxyethyl (6R,7R)-7-[2-(Z)-(O-methyloxime)-2-(furanylcarbonyl)amino]-3-(hydroxymethyl)-8-oxo-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylate, 1-acetate 3-carbamate. Its molecular formula is C20H22N4O10S, and it has a molecular weight of 510.48. Cefuroxime axetil exists in an amorphous form. CEFTIN Tablets are film-coated and are available in dosages equivalent to either 250 mg or 500 mg of cefuroxime, provided as cefuroxime axetil. The tablets also contain several inactive ingredients, including colloidal silicon dioxide, croscarmellose sodium, hydrogenated vegetable oil, hypromellose, methylparaben, microcrystalline cellulose, propylene glycol, propylparaben, sodium benzoate, sodium lauryl sulfate, and titanium dioxide. CEFTIN for Oral Suspension, when reconstituted with water, delivers a dosage equivalent to either 125 mg or 250 mg of cefuroxime (as cefuroxime axetil) per 5 mL of suspension. The oral suspension formulation includes inactive ingredients such as acesulfame potassium, aspartame, povidone K30, stearic acid, sucrose, tutti-frutti flavoring, and xanthan gum.
